column2: each player's life total is set to the highest life total within their range of influence
column3: Inconsistent with CR 801.10 and 801.11 and the other range-of-influence rulings (ruling 2007-10-01; work item ruling-conflicts-3, case 7, conclusion D): its example (Alice 4, Barry 8, Carrie 11, Doug 7, each with a range of one: Alice becomes 8, Barry and Doug 11) gives each affected player the highest life total within that player's own range, but 801.10 ('Spells and abilities can't affect objects or players outside their controller's range of influence.') and 801.11 ('it gets only information from within its controller's range of influence') use the controller's, and no controller fits the example; the CR current as of 2007-10-01 already had both rules word for word (as 601.10 and 601.11), so no rules change explains it; Imperial Mask (2007-05-01: 'Only teammates within the range of influence of Imperial Mask's controller will get a token.') and Benediction of Moons (2006-02-01) use the controller's range. Set aside as inconsistent by the user's decision of Nov 5 (evening; work item register-decisions-nov5b), as Gnoll War Band's ruling was (register each-player-effect-uses-controllers-range, decided; logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md). The card's other two rulings are cited; the engine follows the CR (tests/rulings/r_p014_catch_up.rs, arbiter_of_knollridge_with_range_of_influence_uses_its_controllers_range: with Alice controlling it, Alice, Barry and Doug become 8 and Carrie keeps 11).
